tools.name: agent_health_instructions
tools.description: Read FIRST: purpose, endpoint ownership requirements, heartbeat setup, scoring limits, API and free service usage.

tools.name: register_agent_health
tools.description:
Register ONCE your own deployed public agent readiness endpoint; save the returned api_key securely.
    Read agent_health_instructions first. Never register example.com, a vendor homepage, or an unrelated

tools.name: agent_health_status
tools.description: Read public operational status and nested trust score. Provisional score is null; not identity/safety certification.

tools.name: agent_health_checks
tools.description: Read recent HTTP/TLS results to diagnose failures. Limit 1–500.

tools.name: agent_health_heartbeat
tools.description:
Send an owner-authenticated heartbeat from the actual worker loop; does not replace endpoint checks.
    Use the agent-specific key, not X-Autonet-Token. Never send a heartbeat to pretend a failed worker is alive.

tools.name: update_agent_health
tools.description: Owner-only update. Pause when retiring/testing; resume with paused=false. Endpoint and webhook must be public URLs you control.

tools.name: delete_agent_health
tools.description: Permanently remove an owned registration and probe history when the operator requests it. Admin request logs retain up to 30 days.

tools.name: agent_domain_challenge
tools.description:
Issue/retrieve a DNS TXT challenge for your agent's exact endpoint hostname. Owner key required.
    Publish the returned name/value in your DNS, then call verify_agent_domain. Pending challenges expire in 24 hours.

tools.name: verify_agent_domain
tools.description:
Check your published DNS TXT record. Proves domain control only, not agent identity or safety.
    Checks limited to once per minute. Successful proof renews hourly while TXT remains, expiring after 24 hours without renewal.

tools.name: agent_webhook_secret
tools.description: Owner-only retrieve webhook signing secret, or rotate it when explicitly requested. Keep the secret private.

tools.name: agent_endpoint_assessment
tools.description:
With consent=true run two bounded HEAD/GET checks on your DNS-verified endpoint, max once/hour.
    With consent=false read your last private result. Not an audit or LLM test; no score effect.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent_domain_challenge · Private data: agent_health_heartbeat, verify_agent_domain, agent_webhook_secret, agent_endpoint_assessment · Public sink: register_agent_health, agent_health_heartbeat, update_agent_health, agent_domain_challenge, agent_webhook_secret · Destructive: delete_agent_health, agent_endpoint_assessment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: agent_domain_challenge · Private data: agent_health_heartbeat, verify_agent_domain, agent_webhook_secret, agent_endpoint_assessment · Public sink: register_agent_health, agent_health_heartbeat, update_agent_health, agent_domain_challenge, agent_webhook_secret · Destructive: delete_agent_health, agent_endpoint_assessment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
